text:
Maya R.: hey team :wave: quick question — first week and trying to track down the canonical onboarding docs + the team templates for eng. I can open the company home page but I don't see the 'Eng onboarding' pages or the 'API templates' folder. Where do those live and who do I ping for edit access?

Tara (DevEx): hey @Maya R. — welcome! :tada: The most common place is the Workspace sidebar -> Spaces -> Engineering -> Onboarding & Templates. Direct link (read-only): https://redwood.notion.site/Engineering-Onboarding-templates. If you need edit rights, please fill the quick access form and mention which team page(s): https://forms.redwood.com/notion-edit-request.

Sam C.: to add, team templates are nested under "Team Resources" on that page. We keep two template families: "Feature PRD + Runbook" and "Endpoint Add". Owners are tagged on each template (hover the page title -> Owner column). If a template doesn't list an owner, ping @Tara (DevEx) or open the form — we route it to the right person.

Maya R.: ah got it — thanks. If I want to create a new onboarding checklist for infra-integration, should I duplicate the team checklist or make a fresh page and link it from the Onboarding index? Trying to avoid duplicate copies floating around. :thinking_face:

Jin L.: duplicate the checklist template and then update the title + owner meta. Steps I use:
1) open the template page -> ••• -> Duplicate
2) rename to "Infra Integration - Onboarding (Maya R.)"
3) edit the top metadata block: Owner = Maya R., Team = Infra
4) Add link back to the Onboarding index under Related Pages (so people find it)
If you want, I can add the page to the index after you hand ownership.

Tara (DevEx): @Maya R. — do you need edit permission right now? I can add you to the Eng space editors for the duration of your onboarding. LMK which email you signed up with and I'll grant access. Also we try to keep templates in the same folder and use the naming convention: [Team] - [Doc Type] - [Short name].

docs-bot: Notion — You were invited to "Engineering Onboarding" (view).

Maya R.: perfect, sending my email in DM @Tara. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
